_comment: Two ways to start crystod-mcp. Keep one 'crystod' entry: 'python -m crystod_mcp' uses the interpreter where crystod-mcp (and CrystOD) are installed; the uvx form fetches crystod-mcp from PyPI into its own environment. CRYSTOD_MCP_TIMEOUT (seconds, default 60) bounds the wait of every tool call; a calculation already running in a worker thread finishes in the background.
